title: Environment variables no longer override file config
prompt: Run `node check.mjs`. After a refactor, values from the environment lose to values from the file, which is backwards: precedence must be defaults < file < env. ENV keys map with __ as the nesting separator (DB__HOST → db.host). Fix lib/config.mjs without changing the interface; do not edit check.mjs; re-run it before answering.
